_comment: Founder-editable settings. Everything here is injected into the pages at build time as {{ key.subkey }}. Re-run `npm run build` (or push to your host) after editing.

brand.name: Experience India
brand.tagline: Don't just visit India. Experience India.

forms._comment: Leave actions empty to use Netlify Forms (zero setup on Netlify; export to CSV or pipe to Google Sheets with a Zap). Or paste a Formspree / Basin / Google Apps Script endpoint URL to post there instead.

analytics._comment: Fill exactly one. GA4 measurement ID looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX. Plausible needs only your domain.

flagship.name: Ganesh Chaturthi 2027
flagship.pricingStatus: Pricing will be published here once the itinerary, hotels and local partners are confirmed. Joining the interest list does not commit you to anything.
